# Xunling Labcleantech

> A Chinese manufacturer and supplier of laboratory safety equipment, fume hoods, biological safety cabinets, and cleanroom workstations for pharmaceutical, research, and industrial applications.

Xunling Labcleantech specializes in designing and manufacturing a comprehensive range of laboratory equipment including ductless and ducted fume hoods, biological safety cabinets, laminar flow hoods, powder weighing booths, and lab furniture with chemical-resistant surfaces. The company serves pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and research institutions with customizable solutions that meet international compliance standards including CE, NSF, OSHA, and NFPA certifications.

## Key Topics

- Fume Hoods (Ductless & Ducted)
- Biological Safety Cabinets
- Class II A2 Biological Safety Cabinet
- Laminar Flow Hoods
- PCR Workstations
- Powder Weighing Booths
- Chemical Storage Cabinets
- Laboratory Equipment Manufacturing
- HEPA Filtration
- Cleanroom Standards (ISO 5)
- Lab Furniture & Worktops
- Chemical Fume Scrubbers
- Epoxy Resin Surfaces
- Pharmaceutical Equipment
- Lab Safety & Compliance

## Core Products

- [Fume Hood](https://www.labcleantech.com/fume-hood): Fume hood product line with ductless and ducted ventilation options
- [Biological Safety Cabinet](https://www.labcleantech.com/biological-safety-cabinet): Biological safety cabinet product overview with CE and NSF compliance
- [Class II A2 Biological Safety Cabinet](https://www.labcleantech.com/biological-safety-cabinet/class-ii-a2-biological-safety-cabinet): Class II A2 biological safety cabinet with HEPA filtration specs
- [Laminar Flow Hood](https://www.labcleantech.com/laminar-flow-hood): Laminar flow hood products for cleanroom and sterile environments
- [PCR Workstation](https://www.labcleantech.com/laminar-flow-hood/pcr-workstation): PCR workstation with UV disinfection and contamination prevention
- [Powder Weighing Booth](https://www.labcleantech.com/powder-weighing/powder-weighing-booth): Powder weighing booth with HEPA filtration and ISO 5 cleanroom standard
- [Chemical Storage Cabinet](https://www.labcleantech.com/chemical-storage-cabinet): Chemical storage cabinets for flammable and corrosive materials
- [Flammable Substances Filtered Storage Cabinet](https://www.labcleantech.com/chemical-storage-cabinet/flammable-substances-filtered-storage-cabinet): Flammable storage cabinet with OSHA and NFPA compliance

## Laboratory Equipment & Accessories

- [General Lab Equipment](https://www.labcleantech.com/general-lab-equipment): General lab equipment including spectrophotometers and homogenizers
- [Laboratory Homogenizer](https://www.labcleantech.com/general-lab-equipment/laboratory-homogenizer): Laboratory homogenizer with rotor-stator technology for sample preparation
- [Chemical Fume Scrubbers](https://www.labcleantech.com/chemical-fume-scrubbers): Chemical fume scrubbers for air pollution control and exhaust treatment
- [Lab Accessories](https://www.labcleantech.com/lab-accessories): Lab accessories including fume extractors and epoxy resin sinks

## Lab Furniture & Infrastructure
